title: Izwi Lokwethemba
intro: Kudala ngaphambi kokuba umuntu wokuqala ahambe emhlabeni, isidalwa esinamandla amakhulu sasimi endaweni yokuthula okuphelele, sizungezwe imiphefumulo ezinikele kakhulu. Lapho kunikezwa umyalo owodwa, wonke amazwi akhothama ngokuzithoba—kodwa izwi elilodwa laphakama ngokuvukela, futhi lokho kuvukela kwakuzozwakala kuyo yonke iminyaka kuze kube uSuku lokugcina. Ubani lesi sidalwa esiwile?
clues: Ngadalwa ngento eyayivutha kakhulu, kanti abanye eceleni kwami ​​badalwa ngalokho abahamba kukho.
Ngahlala endaweni engcwele phakathi kwezidalwa ezizinikele, kwaze kwaba yilapho umyalo owodwa uguqula konke kwaba yiphutha.
Lapho kufika umyalo, yonke imiphefumulo yakhothama ngaphandle kwami; ukwenqaba kwami ​​kwazalwa ngokuziqhenya.
Ngaxoshwa kuleyo ndawo engcwele, ngabekwa uphawu lwesiqalekiso esasizohlala phakade.
Ngacela isikhathi kuze kube uSuku Lokuvuka, futhi savunyelwa. Ngafunga ukusondela kuyo yonke imiphefumulo ngiyidukise.
Lapho icilongo likhala, labo abangilandelayo bayohlanganyela nami esiphelweni sami, bahlanganyele nami emlilweni ovuthayo lapho kungekho msizi ongabasindisa khona.

options: Ukuhola abantu ukuba bakhulekele isithombe segolide

outcome.label: Isiphetho Sokugcina

outcome.answer: Ukuxoshwa, ngokuphumula kuze kube usuku oluthenjisiwe

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
